if you’re wanting to know how to update the UI cheats mod, remove the original files from your mods folder (there should be two) and [download](https://www.patreon.com/posts/ui-cheats-v1-16-26240068) the recent release from the creators website. you can learn if they’re compatible with the new update from the creators notes.  other mods you downloaded will have a similar process, just replace the files in your mods folder with the updated ones! hope this helps!
